kind: causal active-PCM word and acoustic boundary diagnostic

implementation.nativeEngineCopy: Identical native ownership, timestamp and inference paths; public result types are reused. Only the activity snapshot adds bounded numeric feature collection before its PCM is erased.
implementation.capture: One active mpv decoder, the existing 2-second native mono 16 kHz snapshot every approximately 500 ms; no offline audio extraction.
implementation.wordEvidence: Current and preceding nonoverlapping ASR context with unchanged global matcher, three contiguous exact words, lexical token score >=0.35, positive speech support and original timestamp-edge checks. No word is assigned uniform SRT time.
implementation.repeatObservationGate: The earlier repeated-decode diagnostic gate is not met before the insertion. Single matched-word observations constrain these proposals only; no production absence gate is replaced.
implementation.candidateTiming: Use only words available by the first two-region confirmation and feature times before that observed media position minus 80 ms. Expected boundaries are read after all candidates are ranked.
implementation.confidence: No calibrated feature choice, ambiguity threshold or gap-confirmation rule; none is inferred from these two results.
implementation.wordPassLimitation: A separate diagnostic enumerates word matches; it does not replace production cross-group ambiguity handling or independent-anchor confirmation. Returned word rows can repeat across groups, and counts are observation rows, not counts of distinct spoken words.

historyChecks.initialOutputLabelCorrection: The first successful check log said seven; the script contained nine assertions. The output label was corrected and all nine rerun successfully.

conclusions: Normal active analysis yields the crossing cue word flank only through adjacent context; extra post-hoc decoding is not necessary to obtain that single observation.
The earlier two-recognition before-flank condition is not satisfied by the normal cadence on either insertion. Context reuse is not counted as independent recognition.
With live bounded acoustic features, the highest spectral-tilt proposals remain 36.25/66.39 and 35.18/64.98 seconds, respectively 0.14 and 0.68 seconds from the authored hard-edit boundaries.
Those proposals are only available at media 84.042 and 69.625 seconds, after post-edit mapping confirmation. They do not fix first-playback suppression.

Feature collection peaks at 2.557/2.709 ms per activity call in these diagnostic runs, about 0.200 seconds total per 105-second run. This is not full application CPU/GPU/memory or playback-impact proof.
Both actual scene assessments still fail: no learned gaps and tracking p95 approximately 30.2 seconds.
nextRequiredEvidence: Keep numeric proposals separate from confirmed gaps.
Calibrate ambiguity rejection on additional development edits and negative controls, including continuous audio and crossfades, before consuming held-out fixtures.
Design causal absence detection separately from later boundary recovery; do not exclude errors before recovery to make the frozen p95 pass.
